title: The King of the Wobbly Crown

narrations.title: The Pompous Proclamation
narrations.narration: Leo the Lion puffed out his chest, his red velvet cape sweeping behind him. He adjusted his tiny gold crown, which immediately tipped over his left ear.

narrations.title: The Hidden Friends
narrations.narration: Ruby the Rabbit hopped into the clearing. She pushed her magnifying goggles up her forehead and noticed the Forest Friends huddled together under a bush.

narrations.title: A Trip and a Trick
narrations.narration: Ruby hopped up to Leo, who was trying to eat a snack while strutting. He tripped over his own cape and landed with a soft thump.

narrations.title: The Well Confrontation
narrations.narration: Leo marched toward the mossy well, his pompous strut wobbling. Ruby followed, her ears twitching with excitement.

narrations.title: Staring Down the Rival
narrations.narration: Leo leaned over the edge, glaring into the dark water. He saw his own reflection: a plump lion with a tipped crown.

narrations.title: The Splash
narrations.narration: Leo lunged forward to chase the intruder away, but his heavy cape got caught on his paw. He tumbled forward and landed in the shallow water with a giant, comical splash!

narrations.title: Dripping Defeat
narrations.narration: Leo scrambled out, dripping wet. The Forest Friends peeked out and chirped with laughter. Leo let out a long, dramatic face-paw sigh.

narrations.title: Peace in the Meadow
narrations.narration: Ruby smiled and hopped away. She had solved the puzzle, and the jungle was quiet, peaceful, and perfectly fun.
